enchantments.tooltip: +7 Enhancement Bonus: +7 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Rebellion: Passive: All threat you generate from attacks and spells is reduced by 25%. On Critical Hit: This weapon will strike with exceptional accuracy, dealing an additional 13-78 Piercing damage.

Sneak Attack Bonus +5 : Provides a +5 Enhancement modifier to your attack bonus and a +8 Enhancement bonus to damage for any attack that would qualify as a Sneak Attack, even if the wielder is not a Rogue.
Armor-Piercing 15%: Passive: +15% Enhancement bonus to Fortification Bypass. (Fortification Bypass makes your attacks ignore a percentage of enemy Fortification.)

Improved Deception: This item makes your weapons hard to focus upon and thus provides a +5 enhancement bonus to Bluff checks. In addition, while using this item your weapons have a chance to envelop the target in darkness, making them vulnerable to sneak attacks for a short time.
This relic is attuned to heroic actions.
